content.text: Skip to Main Content Mizzou Men's Basketball - Missouri vs Miami (FL) << Back Header Content Friday, March 20, 2026 tipoff 9:10 pm ct Enterprise Center1401 Clark Ave | St. Louis | MAP The Tigers and Hurricanes are set to tip off at 9:10 p.m. CT on Friday night in the first round, playing in St. Louis' Enterprise Center on truTV.
